detailed_descriptions.en: DISASTER! THE RED DRAGON IN THE BASEMENT SNEEZED. Every coin in the museum is mixed up. Centuries of careful sorting, reduced to one enormous pile. Management would like to reassure you: the dragon is absolutely fine. Your holiday, however, has been cancelled. Welcome to The Coin Keeper : Tidy up ! , a first-person game of sorting and observation. Your job is to return every coin to its rightful place in the museum. One coin at a time. Well… until a little magic lends a hand. HEADS, TAILS… AND BACK WHERE IT BELONGS. A coin doesn’t reveal all its secrets at first glance. Flip it over, rotate it and examine its symbols, material and value. Identify its people, clan and era, then find its place in the museum. Not sure? Consult your guide. Even the best curators need a reminder now and then. ONE LITTLE SNEEZE. ONE ENORMOUS COLLECTION. 6,000 unique coins, 10 peoples and 60 clans : that’s quite a pile to sort through. Explore the collections, learn to recognise their coins and watch the empty slots fill up. A finished row, a complete set, a display restored to its former glory… Every coin you put away brings a little more order to the chaos. SMALL COINS. BIG SATISFACTION. Find the perfect spot for every coin. Fill the gaps, complete the rows, and enjoy the satisfaction of watching your collection come together. EVEN TIDYING UP HAS A SKILL TREE. Earn experience as you restore order and unlock new abilities. Carry more coins, move faster and learn to place several coins in quick succession. Magic can reveal coins from the same series, make them levitate or guide you to their proper places. After all, if a dragon can make this much mess, you’re allowed to bend the laws of physics a little. About that holiday? Take it up with the dragon.

DISASTER! THE RED DRAGON IN THE BASEMENT SNEEZED.

Every coin in the museum is mixed up. Centuries of careful sorting, reduced to one enormous pile.

Management would like to reassure you: the dragon is absolutely fine.

Your holiday, however, has been cancelled.Welcome to The Coin Keeper : Tidy up !, a first-person game of sorting and observation. Your job is to return every coin to its rightful place in the museum. One coin at a time. Well… until a little magic lends a hand.

HEADS, TAILS… AND BACK WHERE IT BELONGS.

A coin doesn’t reveal all its secrets at first glance. Flip it over, rotate it and examine its symbols, material and value. Identify its people, clan and era, then find its place in the museum.

Not sure? Consult your guide. Even the best curators need a reminder now and then.

ONE LITTLE SNEEZE. ONE ENORMOUS COLLECTION.

6,000 unique coins, 10 peoples and 60 clans: that’s quite a pile to sort through.

Explore the collections, learn to recognise their coins and watch the empty slots fill up. A finished row, a complete set, a display restored to its former glory… Every coin you put away brings a little more order to the chaos.

SMALL COINS. BIG SATISFACTION.

Find the perfect spot for every coin. Fill the gaps, complete the rows, and enjoy the satisfaction of watching your collection come together.

EVEN TIDYING UP HAS A SKILL TREE.

Earn experience as you restore order and unlock new abilities. Carry more coins, move faster and learn to place several coins in quick succession.

Magic can reveal coins from the same series, make them levitate or guide you to their proper places.

After all, if a dragon can make this much mess, you’re allowed to bend the laws of physics a little.

About that holiday? Take it up with the dragon.
